thread:
sophia: Heads-up: We rolled out the updated Hybrid Work handbook section this morning. Please read the changes and click "Acknowledge" in the handbook portal by 2026-04-10. Link: https://handbook.redwood.example/policies/hybrid-work

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Handbook update published. Acknowledgement required within 14 days for all full-time employees. Contractors: see note in policy.

ravi: Quick q 12: Does this change desk allocation for SF office?

sophia: @ravi Short answer: yes, desk booking windows are now 7 days instead of 14. Facilities will post the new map later today.

dylan: Can managers bulk-ack on behalf of returning new hires? we've got 3 starters next week.

sophia: No bulk-ack permitted. New hires get a "newstarter" exemption flag for 10 days after their start date; recruiting should add them to the onboarding sheet so we don't auto-penalize. @recruiting-bot will handle tagging.

recruiting-bot: Auto: Added 3 new hires to onboarding sheet (IDs: R-551, R-552, R-553). Start dates: 2026-04-05, 2026-04-06, 2026-04-08. Exemption window applied.

grace: I updated the handbook change log with a short rationale + link to leadership approval doc. File: https://docs.example.com/hybrid-change-approval

sophia: Thanks @grace. Please also drop a short blurb for the all-hands announcement. Keep it 1-2 bullets.

people-ops-bot: Digest: 5 teams fully acknowledged, 9 teams with partial ack, 21 individuals pending. Next reminder will go out 2026-04-03 09:00 UTC.

ravi: For EU employees, is there any additional local addendum?

sophia: We added an EU addendum paragraph for statutory leave interactions. People in EU regions should review the addendum tab in the doc. If something conflicts with local law, local HR will override.

dylan: Hiring ops note: we need a short checklist to hand to hiring managers so they know to add starters to the onboarding sheet and to schedule the handbook walk-through in week 1. I'll draft one and post it in #recruiting.

sophia: Perfect. Keep it 4 bullets: add to onboarding sheet; schedule handbook walkthrough; confirm equipment & desk booking; set 1:1 in week 1.

grace: Done. Posted checklist in #recruiting with a template message managers can copy.

people-ops-bot: Action items created: HR-142 (remind pending acks), HR-143 (desk map update), HR-144 (post all-hands blurb).

sophia: Final note: If you see any roles where the manager is out of cycle (leave, etc.), flag them in the "exceptions" column of the tracking sheet and we'll handle manual follow-up. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
